claim: The demo uses sample data and never writes to the real passbook.
where: first-screen action, demo banner, demo guide, and README
sandbox: seed a real Boiler, enter and reset /demo, leave demo, then prove Boiler remains and demo Furnace does not cross namespaces

claim: Schedules jobs on fixed dates or from the last completion date.
where: landing preview, job form, and README
sandbox: demo records show both recurrence labels; unit tests assert their date behavior

claim: Exports and imports one complete JSON backup, including attached photos.
sandbox: demo data; parse all four collections, round-trip into the real namespace, and separately prove a licensed attachment persists and exports

claim: Records stay in this browser; the app loads no analytics, third-party scripts, or remote fonts.
where: landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: intercept demo load, browsing, and export; assert every request stays on the product origin

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service worker, go offline, reload, and assert sample records

claim: The free passbook holds five assets; House Key costs $19 once, removes the limit, adds local photo attachments, and leaves backup, print, and accessibility free.
where: landing paid section, license panel, privacy page, and README
sandbox: seed five assets; reject an orphan verdict; verify the $19 checkout URL; mock a token-bound verdict; persist, reload, retrieve, and export a photo; check free controls

claim: Records service dates, notes, and receipt references, then keeps them after refresh.
sandbox: empty real namespace; add an asset and completion-relative job, complete it, then retrieve the service entry after reload
demo history; intercept and assert the browser print action

claim: Exports every current job and due date to a calendar file.
sandbox: isolated demo data; parse the downloaded ICS and match one event, due date, asset, area, and recurrence rule for every current job

claim: The passbook records work but does not control appliances, diagnose faults, certify safety, give repair advice, or file warranty claims.
sandbox: inspect the published boundaries and all available demo actions; assert no control, diagnosis, certification, advice, or warranty action and no matching request destination

claim: Assets, recurring jobs, and service entries can be corrected or deleted.
sandbox: demo data; add two assets through the UI to reach the free five-asset limit, then edit an asset, job, and service note; delete the service entry; reload and assert the correction persists

claim: Before replacing your passbook, import checks every area, asset, job, service entry, and attachment.
sandbox: demo backup fixtures with one malformed area, asset, job, service entry, or attachment are each rejected before the confirmation prompt; the sample passbook remains intact

claim: If imported data cannot open later, the app restores the passbook you had before importing.
sandbox: import a valid replacement, corrupt its saved state, reload, and assert the earlier passbook returns
a mocked Sociobot revoked verdict replaces an optimistic cached verdict and paid features immediately lock
